sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Fear of becoming insane; nervous anxiety;
hallucinations of sight and hearing.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Throbbing headache; sensation of constric~
\ion. Flashes of heat. Headache under ears with ear-
iche.

sections.label: Face
sections.text: Oedema and puffiness. Red and swollen.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Swelling of lips. Burning of mouth and
gums. Ulceration of lips and tongue ; vesicles and bulhe.
Small lump in cheek. Tongue swollen. Bloody saliva.
Toothache along lower jaw.

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Pain on swallowing. Expectoration of fetid
pus. Abscess, white false membrane. Sensation of
burning.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text: Nausea and vomiting ; burning and pain.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Itching and burning in vagina. Menses
suppressed. Watery leucorrhoea.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Fluent coryza. Nasal mucous mem-
brane swollen. Dull pains in frontal sinus. Aphonia.
Oppression and dyspnoea. Cheyne-Stokes respiration.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text: Faintness, with sensation of stoppage of

sections.label: heart
sections.text:
Throlibing throughout the body. Rapid, weak,
irregular pulse.

Nerves. — Epileptiform seizures. Contractures. Trem-
bling and cramps. Crawling and numbness. General
prostration.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Erythema, eczema, pemphigus. Intense pru-
ritus. Urticaria, appearing and disappearing suddenly,
with internal coldness. Angioneurotic-oedema. Dark
blotches on skin of penis, sometimes with oedema.
